name: full-stack-chat-application
description: Real-time chat app: React (Vite) + Node.js/Express + Socket.io + SQLite

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run build
